faq:
Frequently Asked Questions

Do you work as a salon interior designer in Rajokri?

Yes. We design salons in Rajokri and nearby areas such as Vasant Kunj, Mahipalpur and Gurgaon, from compact studios to large unisex salons.

Can a salon be designed inside a farmhouse or residence?

Yes. Some salons and bridal studios in the Rajokri area run from farmhouses or homes. We give them a separate entry, wash area and proper ventilation.

What finishes work best for a salon?

Water-resistant floors, stain-resistant counters, washable wall finishes and good-quality upholstery that stays neat with daily cleaning.

Why hire a salon interior designer before signing a lease?

A designer can check whether the space supports wash stations, power load and the number of chairs you need, before you commit.
